answer: Watch how keys grade each other, not just what they write. If two keys agree with each other on more than 95% of shared grading seats while the rest of the panel agrees only 60%, that cedar-straight alignment marks a ring. Their grades get weight zero for 30 epochs and their stake funds a re-grade. A farm trying to bridge 50 puppets into a voting bloc must grade independently and wrongly, which tanks each puppet's accuracy score, so the ring climbs one terrace and slides back.
